_about: Beginner-English reasons for each dip buy in data/holdings.json buys[], keyed "date|time_et|ticker". what = what the price did; why_this = why this specific stock or fund (from the logged reason; "Not logged" if the log has no stock-specific reason). Written by the after-close agent after scripts/add_buy.py; scripts/build_trade_notes.py adds empty skeletons for new buys.

2026-10-15|13:29|VXUS.what: International stocks fell with the whole market after hot inflation reports (Oct 14 and 15). VXUS dipped below its $83.34 floor (its 20-day low), then held above it all afternoon. It was 4.5% below its recent high.
2026-10-15|13:29|VXUS.why_this: It’s part of the Safe Core (broad, diversified funds), which our rules buy first in a market-wide selloff. No bad news about the fund itself.

2026-10-15|15:27|SMH.what: Chip stocks fell worldwide on the hot inflation data. SMH dropped to $540.59, then climbed back above its $557.56 floor. It was 11.7% below its recent high.
2026-10-15|15:27|SMH.why_this: TSMC, a big part of SMH, had just reported strong results and raised its outlook that morning, so the drop wasn’t about the chip business. We picked SMH over NVDA because NVDA couldn’t hold its own floor that afternoon.
